buildd-noop.what: same daemon, its cost on a lone no-op `test` (client, socket, source stamp, extra exec)
buildd-noop.note: opt-in, so `on` is the non-default side; nothing to coalesce, pure overhead

buildd-coalesce.what: resident build daemon: a second agent asking for the identical build attaches to the running one instead of waiting for its slot and re-running cargo and the tests (opt-in JUSTRUST_BUILDD=1)
buildd-coalesce.note: one test-fn edit, then agent A and, 1s later, agent B run the identical reference-loop command; B's wall is measured. Off, B joins A's slot (slots.rs join_identical) and runs a no-op cargo after it

buildd-prebuild.what: resident build daemon prebuilds the agent's last request when its sources change (opt-in JUSTRUST_BUILDD=1 JUSTRUST_BUILDD_PREBUILD=1)
buildd-prebuild.note: reference loop with agent think time: edit, wait BUILDD_THINK seconds (default 4.6, the median gap between an agent's last edit and its build call in 2,241 mined calls), then the build; its wall is measured. Both sides wait the same

buildd-loop.what: same daemon on the reference loop (one agent, nothing to coalesce)
